title: Altera Place
description: A canonical skiable location in the Altera platform

name.description: Canonical English name. The root of the fallback chain when no name_i18n match exists.

name_i18n.description: Locale-keyed display names. Keys are ISO 639-1 language codes (e.g. ko, en, ja). Matches the LocalizedText shape in paulkim-xr/SkiWatch.

homepage.description: Optional public homepage of the resort. When present, consumers render a 'Visit homepage' link in the resort header.

air_korea_station.description: Optional. AirKorea (한국환경공단) station name to use when fetching real-time air quality. Korean station names like '평창', '홍천', '춘천'. Consumed by the Ridgecast registry-sync job to populate places.air_korea_station; when present, /v1/places/{slug}/air-quality returns live data from that station.

provenance.description: Optional. Where this record's data originated. See NOTICE for the attribution policy and CONTRIBUTING.md for guidance on each source class. Currently optional — `scripts/check-provenance.mjs` reports coverage but does not fail when missing.

source.description: osm = derived from OpenStreetMap (must preserve ODbL attribution); operator = official resort / lift co / tourism board; user-edit = correction submitted via PR or editor; import = seed data migrated from another project.

osm_way_id.description: OSM way id when source = 'osm'. Lets re-syncs detect upstream geometry changes.

osm_node_ids.description: Optional OSM node ids used for this record (e.g., the node ids underlying a lift terminal or slope polyline).

osm_version.description: OSM way/node version at the time of import. Used by the importer to skip records that have not changed upstream.

contributor.description: OSM mapper handle (for source='osm'), GitHub username (for source='user-edit'), or import job id (for source='import').

source_url.description: Official source URL when source='operator' — resort homepage, press release, tourism board page.

last_verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when a human last confirmed this fact is still accurate.
